howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 PM PDT 16 August 2026 Tonight and Monday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 5 to 15 knots except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections late this afternoon and early this evening. Wind becoming northerly outflow 5 to 15 near midnight then becoming light Monday morning. Wind becoming southerly inflow 10 to 15 near noon Monday except southwesterly inflow 20 over northern sections Monday afternoon and evening. Showers ending this evening with a risk of thunderstorms.
